READ-BACK: Conversations Site (conversations-site)

THE PLACE

  Conversations Site (conversations-site)
    - The site `conversations-site` is “Conversations Site”, a version 5 site document; its void is
        transparent, its lighting bright and its standing rule centre-covered. [key]
    - The floor is 1 region with cells: Hall (region-hall). Summarised: their cells, lighting and ground are
        not said one by one. [room.room.regions]
    - Summarised: the coordinate frame, 0 wall lines with 0 doors in their openings, 0 scene items, 0 prop
        footprints and 0 arrangements. Their positions and shapes are not said one by one. [room.room.walls]
    - The party starts at q 0, r 6, in Hall (region-hall). [room.room.partyStart]
    - The party's sharing is not set, so it is shared view, the default. [(engine rule)]
    - The record `invitation`: whoever comes to hold it learns the fact `feast-tonight`. [intel[0]]

  Where the places join
    - Hall (region-hall) joins no other region: no door, open floor or passage leads from Hall to another
        region. [room.room.regions[1]]

SIDES

  Faction `watch`
    - The faction `watch` is Guard (gate-1), Guard (gate-2) and Guard (captain). [factions[0]]

  How the sides stand
    - The factions `watch` and `party` start neutral. [dispositions[0]]

CREATURES

  Guard (gate-1): a dnd5e:monsters:guard of `watch` at q 1, r 0 in Hall, facing s
      [room.room.monsterDeclarations[0]]
    - Carries the conversation `gate-claims`: its lines `troupe`, `come-quietly` and `never-alive` (said under
        that conversation). [.options[0]]

  Guard (gate-2): a dnd5e:monsters:guard of `watch` at q 3, r 0 in Hall, facing s
      [room.room.monsterDeclarations[1]]
    - Carries the conversation `gate-claims`: its lines `troupe`, `come-quietly` and `never-alive` (said under
        that conversation). [.options[0]]

  Guard (captain): a dnd5e:monsters:guard of `watch` at q 5, r 0 in Hall, facing s
      [room.room.monsterDeclarations[2]]
    - Carries the conversation `gate-claims`: its lines `troupe`, `come-quietly` and `never-alive` (said under
        that conversation). [.options[1]]
    - At `speak`, the guard's words reach everyone in the guard's room (the wall partition the guard stands
        in), and anyone in the next room within 30 feet of the guard by the way through an open doorway (a
        closed door stops them), and whoever it is said to, wherever they stand. [said for every answer below
        at `speak`]
    - “We’re invited guests of His Majesty, here for the feast.” (`guest`), said to the guard; checked, an
        action (a round of the world out of a fight); rolls Persuasion vs DC 11 [.options[0].check]
      - Offered while: `front-gate` is in `fresh` or `warned-troupe`. [.requires[0]]
      - On a win: the guard answers “Then welcome. Through to the hall.”, at `speak`; and the line steps
          `front-gate` with `admitted`: to `admitted` from `fresh` or `warned-troupe` [.success[0], .advance]
      - On a miss: the line steps `front-gate` with `guest-failed`: to `warned-guest` from `fresh`, to
          `arrested` from `warned-troupe` [.advance]

CONVERSATIONS

  The lines of `gate-claims` — Lines written once: `troupe`, `come-quietly` and `never-alive`. Carried by 3
      carriers (Guard (gate-1), Guard (gate-2) and Guard (captain)). [conversations.gate-claims]
    - At `speak`, the carrier's words reach everyone in the carrier's room (the wall partition the carrier
        stands in), and anyone in the next room within 30 feet of the carrier by the way through an open
        doorway (a closed door stops them), and whoever it is said to, wherever they stand. [said for every
        answer below at `speak`]
    - At `shout`, the carrier's words reach everyone in the carrier's room and the next room over (a closed
        door on the way counts as a room), and whoever it is said to, wherever they stand. [said for every
        answer below at `shout`]
    - “We’re the troupe for tonight’s feast.” (`troupe`), said to the carrier; checked, an action (a round of
        the world out of a fight); rolls Performance vs DC 13, or Deception vs DC 15
        [conversations.gate-claims .lines[0].check]
      - Offered while: the speaker knows the fact `feast-tonight` and `front-gate` is in `fresh` or
          `warned-guest`. [.requires[0], .requires[1]]
      - On a win: the carrier answers “Through to the hall, then. Don’t dawdle.”, at `speak`; and the line
          steps `front-gate` with `admitted`: to `admitted` from `fresh` or `warned-guest` [.success[0],
          .advance]
      - On a miss: the carrier answers “Troupe? There’s no troupe on my list. What’s going on here?”, at
          `speak`; and the line steps `front-gate` with `troupe-failed`: to `warned-troupe` from `fresh`, to
          `arrested` from `warned-guest` [.failure[0], .advance]
    - “We’ll come quietly.” (`come-quietly`), said to the carrier; plain: rolls nothing, cannot be missed,
        free [conversations.gate-claims .lines[1]]
      - Offered while: `front-gate` is in `arrested`. [.requires[0]]
      - When said: the carrier answers “Sensible. This way, and keep your hands where I can see them.”, at
          `speak`; and the line steps `front-gate` with `came-quietly`: to `admitted` from `arrested`
          [.success[0], .advance]
    - “You will never take me alive.” (`never-alive`), said to the carrier; plain: rolls nothing, cannot be
        missed, free [conversations.gate-claims .lines[2]]
      - Offered while: `front-gate` is in `arrested`. [.requires[0]]
      - When said: the carrier answers “Then we do this the hard way. To arms!”, at `shout`; every member
          those words reach, seen or not, the carrier included, learns the fact `refused-arrest` [.success[0]]

  Conversation `front-gate` — one state for the whole run, shared by every speaker; starts in `fresh`; recipe
      `site:interactions:front-gate`. Carried by Guard (gate-1), Guard (gate-2) and Guard (captain) (the
      creatures whose lines read or step it). [interactions.front-gate]
    - When a character's own step ends within 2 cells of a carrier who sees them and whom they see, both up
        and out of a fight, and that carrier offers them a line that steps `front-gate`, the nearest such
        carrier (then by id) hails them and hears the beat `approached`, unless `front-gate` is already
        addressing someone. A line that only reads `front-gate` does not hail. It is opened within 2 cells,
        and stands while the other conditions hold and the character is within Speak reach of that carrier
        (never less than 2 cells); it ends when any fails. [.approach]
    - Who can hail for `front-gate`, by its state: in `fresh`, Guard (gate-1) and Guard (gate-2) (by `troupe`,
        if the speaker knows the fact `feast-tonight`), and Guard (captain) (by `guest`; by `troupe`, if the
        speaker knows the fact `feast-tonight`); in `arrested`, Guard (gate-1), Guard (gate-2) and Guard
        (captain) (by `come-quietly`); in `warned-guest`, Guard (gate-1), Guard (gate-2) and Guard (captain)
        (by `troupe`, if the speaker knows the fact `feast-tonight`); in `warned-troupe`, Guard (captain) (by
        `guest`); in `admitted`, nobody. [.approach]
    - From `fresh`: `guest-failed` moves it to `warned-guest` (“the guest claim failed”); sent by a miss of
        `guest` (captain). [.recipe.states.fresh.transitions[0]]
    - From `fresh`: `troupe-failed` moves it to `warned-troupe` (“the troupe claim failed”); sent by a miss of
        `troupe` (gate-1, gate-2, captain). [.recipe.states.fresh.transitions[1]]
    - From `fresh`: `admitted` moves it to `admitted` (“let through”); sent by a win of `troupe` (gate-1,
        gate-2, captain) or a win of `guest` (captain). [.recipe.states.fresh.transitions[2]]
    - From `arrested`: `came-quietly` moves it to `admitted` (“the arrested went quietly”); sent by saying
        `come-quietly` (gate-1, gate-2, captain). [.recipe.states.arrested.transitions[0]]
    - From `warned-guest`: `troupe-failed` moves it to `arrested` (“the second claim failed”); sent by a miss
        of `troupe` (gate-1, gate-2, captain). [.recipe.states.warned-guest.transitions[0]]
    - From `warned-guest`: `admitted` moves it to `admitted` (“let through”); sent by a win of `troupe`
        (gate-1, gate-2, captain). [.recipe.states.warned-guest.transitions[1]]
    - From `warned-troupe`: `guest-failed` moves it to `arrested` (“the second claim failed”); sent by a miss
        of `guest` (captain). [.recipe.states.warned-troupe.transitions[0]]
    - From `warned-troupe`: `admitted` moves it to `admitted` (“let through”); sent by a win of `guest`
        (captain). [.recipe.states.warned-troupe.transitions[1]]
    - `admitted` is final: once entered, nothing moves it again. [.recipe.states.admitted]
    - On entering `admitted`: the creature the deciding line was said to notes `admitted` about the speaker
        and every member of the speaker's party that creature sees then; so does each other carrier of
        `front-gate` the line's words reached and who is up, about the same members, whether or not that
        carrier sees them (heard); if that creature notes it about nobody, nobody else notes anything.
        [.outcomes.admitted[0].give]
    - Lines offered only in a state of it: `troupe` (gate-1, gate-2, captain) in `fresh` or `warned-guest`;
        `come-quietly` and `never-alive` (gate-1, gate-2, captain) in `arrested`; `guest` (captain) in `fresh`
        or `warned-troupe`. [at each line's requires, above]
    - Engine rule, not authored: while a checked line that reads or steps `front-gate` waits on its speaker's
        decision about a held benefit, every line that reads or steps `front-gate` is pending for every
        speaker until that roll is settled or released. [(engine rule)]
    - Engine rule, not authored: if the speaker and the creature spoken to lose reach or sight of each other
        while that roll waits, the speaker keeps the roll they made: it is settled as rolled, judged where the
        words were spoken. [(engine rule)]
    - Engine rule, not authored: a reply sent from a menu offered before `front-gate` last changed (a state
        change, or a roll beginning or ending its wait on it) is refused with nothing spent; the speaker must
        be offered the menu again. [(engine rule)]
